high_level_description: The image depicts a university campus scene with a modern architectural building in the background. The building has large glass windows and a geometric design, with the letters "UNSW" prominently displayed on the facade, indicating that it is likely the University of New South Wales (UNSW) in Sydney, Australia. In the foreground, there is a wide pathway lined with trees and greenery, leading up to the main entrance of the building. Several people are walking along the pathway, some individually and others in small groups.
